تستنسخون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْسِخُونَ (tastansiḵūna) /tas.tan.si.xuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
# تُسْتَنْسَخُونَ (tustansaḵūna) /tus.tan.sa.xuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْسَخَ (istansaḵa)
